start.text: You stand in the grey and listen. A great many voices, none of them getting to the end of the line, all of them starting it again together, so that nobody's left behind.
Isolde stands apart from them by the cradle, not singing. Keeping the time.
Over the rest, one voice finishes the line every time now, and goes back for the others.
One voice keeps breaking off to talk, and coming back in on the beat.
Here and there in the grey, a word you know. A boat's name. A kind of bread. Somebody's mother. Nine hundred years of the Lanternreach, kept by people who aren't anybody now, for nobody.
The ember is warm. It's the only warm thing in the room, and the grey leans to it, a little, the way your hands lean to a fire.
